title: Chapter of the learning path
description: src/chapters/<id>/chapter.json. A 'ready' chapter also has main.js (its script), panels.html (its tab panels) and logo.svg; scripts/build.mjs turns it into <id>.html.

id.description: Also the folder name and the page name (<id>.html).

order.description: Position on the learning path; chapters are numbered in this order.

status.description: planned: listed as 'coming soon', no page is built.

short.description: Short name, used in links to this chapter from other pages.

title.description: Browser tab title, before ' · Bölüm N'.

brand.description: Title in the top bar, when it differs from the chapter title.
